high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a bathroom or dressing area. The individual is standing in front of a plain white wall with a tiled floor. They are wearing a green button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, dark jeans, and white sneakers. The person has their left hand in their pocket and is holding a smartphone in their right hand, which they are using to take the photo. The person's hair is styled upwards, giving it a spiky look. They have a watch on their left wrist and a necklace around their neck.
